categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Fuzzing' and modifies fuzz harness infrastructure (src/test/fuzz/process_message*.cpp and test validation utilities) to enable the block filter index.
categories.rationale: Extends fuzz harnesses to cover BIP 157 compact block filter P2P message handlers, a high-risk code path that was previously skipped. The harness improvement immediately demonstrated utility by exposing a runtime integer overflow under UBSan in net_processing (referencing #36321).
